reason: I merged three agent PRs this week on faith and green tests, so a free, offline tool where the diff is plain code is worth one afternoon on our own repo. If it doesn't catch something real or drowns me in noise, I drop it.
objection: Recording scenarios and keeping them alive is work, and I expect the masking to miss half our nondeterministic fields so every replay screams false diffs. A one-cent demo in a README is a curated example, not my codebase.
would_change_my_mind: If the first run on our app is mostly false positives or setup takes more than an hour, I'm out.
